suppressImplicitAnyIndexErrors.description:
Suppress noImplicitAny errors for indexing objects lacking index signatures.

Deprecated: This option will be removed in TypeScript 5.5.

stripInternal.description: Do not emit declarations for code that has an `@internal` annotation.

useUnknownInCatchVariables.description: Default catch clause variables as `unknown` instead of `any`.

watch.description:
Watch input files.

Deprecated: Use watchOptions instead.

fallbackPolling.description:
Specify the polling strategy to use when the system runs out of or doesn't support native file watchers.

Deprecated: Use watchOptions.fallbackPolling instead.

watchDirectory.description:
Specify the strategy for watching directories under systems that lack recursive file-watching functionality.

Deprecated: Use watchOptions.watchDirectory instead.

watchFile.description:
Specify the strategy for watching individual files.

Deprecated: Use watchOptions.watchFile instead.

experimentalDecorators.description: Enables experimental support for ES7 decorators.

emitDecoratorMetadata.description: Emit design-type metadata for decorated declarations in source.

allowUnusedLabels.description: Do not report errors on unused labels.

noImplicitReturns.description: Report error when not all code paths in function return a value.

noUncheckedIndexedAccess.description: Add `undefined` to a type when accessed using an index.

noUncheckedSideEffectImports.description: Report error if failed to find a source file for a side effect import.

noFallthroughCasesInSwitch.description: Report errors for fallthrough cases in switch statement.

noImplicitOverride.description: Ensure overriding members in derived classes are marked with an override modifier.

allowUnreachableCode.description: Do not report errors on unreachable code.

forceConsistentCasingInFileNames.description: Disallow inconsistently-cased references to the same file.

generateCpuProfile.description: Emit a v8 CPU profile of the compiler run for debugging.

generateTrace.description: Generates an event trace and a list of types.

baseUrl.description: Base directory to resolve non-relative module names.

paths.description: Specify path mapping to be computed relative to baseUrl option.

rootDirs.description: Specify list of root directories to be used when resolving modules.

typeRoots.description: Specify list of directories for type definition files to be included.

types.description: Type declaration files to be included in compilation.

traceResolution.description: Enable tracing of the name resolution process.

allowJs.description: Allow javascript files to be compiled.

allowSyntheticDefaultImports.description: Allow default imports from modules with no default export. This does not affect code emit, just typechecking.

noImplicitUseStrict.description:
Do not emit `'use strict'` directives in module output.

Deprecated: This option will be removed in TypeScript 5.5.

listEmittedFiles.description: Enable to list all emitted files.

disableSizeLimit.description: Disable size limit for JavaScript project.

lib.description: List of library files to be included in the compilation.

maxNodeModuleJsDepth.description: The maximum dependency depth to search under `node_modules` and load JavaScript files. Only applicable with `--allowJs`.

importHelpers.description: Import emit helpers (e.g. `__extends`, `__rest`, etc..) from tslib.

importsNotUsedAsValues.description:
Specify emit/checking behavior for imports that are only used for types.

Deprecated: Use `verbatimModuleSyntax` instead.

alwaysStrict.description: Parse in strict mode and emit `'use strict'` for each source file.

strict.description: Enable all strict type checking options.

strictBindCallApply.description: Enable stricter checking of of the `bind`, `call`, and `apply` methods on functions.

downlevelIteration.description: Provide full support for iterables in `for-of`, spread, and destructuring when targeting `ES5` or `ES3`.

strictBuiltinIteratorReturn.description: Built-in iterators are instantiated with a `TReturn` type of undefined instead of `any`.

strictFunctionTypes.description: Disable bivariant parameter checking for function types.

strictPropertyInitialization.description: Ensure non-undefined class properties are initialized in the constructor.

esModuleInterop.description: Emit `__importStar` and `__importDefault` helpers for runtime Babel ecosystem compatibility and enable `--allowSyntheticDefaultImports` for typesystem compatibility.

allowUmdGlobalAccess.description: Allow accessing UMD globals from modules.

keyofStringsOnly.description:
Resolve `keyof` to string valued property names only (no numbers or symbols).

Deprecated: This option will be removed in TypeScript 5.5.

declarationMap.description: Generates a sourcemap for each corresponding `.d.ts` file.

assumeChangesOnlyAffectDirectDependencie.description: Have recompiles in '--incremental' and '--watch' assume that changes within a file will only affect files directly depending on it.

extendedDiagnostics.description: Output more detailed compiler performance information after building.

listFilesOnly.description: Print names of files that are part of the compilation and then stop processing.

disableSourceOfProjectReferenceRedirect.description: Disable preferring source files instead of declaration files when referencing composite projects.

disableSolutionSearching.description: Opt a project out of multi-project reference checking when editing.

explainFiles.description: Print names of files which TypeScript sees as a part of your project and the reason they are part of the compilation.

preserveValueImports.description:
Preserve unused imported values in the JavaScript output that would otherwise be removed.

Deprecated: Use `verbatimModuleSyntax` instead.

moduleSuffixes.description: List of file name suffixes to search when resolving a module.

moduleDetection.description: Control what method is used to detect module-format JS files.

allowImportingTsExtensions.description: Allows TypeScript files to import each other with a TypeScript-specific extension like .ts, .mts, or .tsx.

resolvePackageJsonExports.description: Forces TypeScript to consult the exports field of package.json files if it ever reads from a package in node_modules.

resolvePackageJsonImports.description: Forces TypeScript to consult the imports field of package.json files when performing a lookup that starts with # from a file whose ancestor directory contains a package.json.

allowArbitraryExtensions.description: Suppress errors for file formats that TypeScript does not understand.

customConditions.description: List of additional conditions that should succeed when TypeScript resolves from package.json.

verbatimModuleSyntax.description: Anything that uses the type modifier is dropped entirely.

erasableSyntaxOnly.description: Do not allow runtime constructs that are not part of ECMAScript.

oxc.description:
Options for the `oxc` generator.

The top-level {@link GeneralOptions.sourcemapsourcemap} option controls
declaration maps.

tsgo.description:
**[Experimental]** Options for the `tsgo` generator.

Used when {@link GeneralOptions.generatorgenerator} is `'tsgo'` or
TypeScript 7 is detected.

customLanguages.description:
Registers non-standard source languages such as Vue or Astro.

If a language is supported via {@link https://volarjs.dev Volar},
{@link CustomLanguage.volarTypeScript} and
{@link CustomLanguage.createVolarPlugins} are both required. Volar
languages require `tsc`; `tsgo` does not support custom languages.

generator.description:
The generator used to produce declaration files.

- `'tsc'` supports the full TypeScript type system.
- `'oxc'` is faster but requires code compatible with
  [`isolatedDeclarations`](https://www.typescriptlang.org/tsconfig/#isolatedDeclarations).
- `'tsgo'` uses the experimental TypeScript Go compiler.

When omitted, the plugin selects `'oxc'` for `isolatedDeclarations`,
`'tsgo'` for TypeScript 7, and `'tsc'` otherwise. Volar-based custom
languages require `'tsc'`.

entry.description:
Glob pattern(s) that select source files for declaration generation.

Patterns are relative to {@link cwd} and may be negated with `!`. Matching
files are emitted even when they are not Rolldown entry points.

cwd.description: Base directory for config discovery, glob matching, and relative paths.

dtsInput.description: Treats entry files as existing declarations instead of source files.

emitDtsOnly.description: Removes non-declaration chunks from the output.

tsconfig.description:
A `tsconfig.json` path, resolved relative to {@link cwd}.

When omitted or `true`, the nearest config is discovered from {@link cwd}.
Set to `false` to disable config loading.

tsconfigRaw.description: Raw `tsconfig.json` values merged over the loaded config.

compilerOptions.description: Compiler options merged over those loaded from `tsconfig.json`.

resolver.description:
Resolver used for declaration imports, including packages in `node_modules`.

Use `'tsc'` when a project depends on TypeScript-specific resolution
behavior; otherwise `'oxc'` is faster.

cjsDefault.description:
Converts a single default export to `export =` for CommonJS consumers.
This does not add support for CommonJS-style declaration input.

sideEffects.description: Marks declaration modules as having side effects during tree-shaking.

build.description: Uses TypeScript build mode (`tsc -b`) and follows project references.

incremental.description:
Persists build-mode outputs, including `.tsbuildinfo`, to disk for reuse.
When disabled, build outputs stay in memory.

parallel.description: Runs `tsc` or `vue-tsc` in a separate process.

eager.description:
Loads every file listed by `tsconfig.json` into the TypeScript program.

Useful when one config covers multiple packages or entry points.

newContext.description: Uses an isolated TypeScript cache instead of the shared global context.

emitJs.description: Generates declarations for JavaScript files with JSDoc types.

gzip.description:
Enable/disable gzip-compressed size reporting.
Compressing large output files can be slow, so disabling this may increase build performance for large projects.

brotli.description:
Enable/disable brotli-compressed size reporting.
Compressing large output files can be slow, so disabling this may increase build performance for large projects.

maxCompressSize.description: Skip reporting compressed size for files larger than this size.

summary.description:
Only report the total size, skipping the per-file breakdown.
Useful for libraries that emit many files in unbundle mode.

devExports.description:
Generate exports that link to source code during development.
- `string`: add as a custom condition.
- `true`: all conditions point to source files, and add `dist` exports to `publishConfig`.

exclude.description:
Specifies file patterns (as glob patterns or regular expressions) to exclude from package exports.
Use this to prevent certain files from being included in the exported package, such as test files, binaries, or internal utilities.

**Note:** Do not include file extensions, and paths should be relative to the dist directory.

legacy.description:
Generate legacy fields (`main`, `module`, and `types`) for older Node.js
versions and bundlers that do not support the package `exports` field.

Defaults to `false` if only ESM builds are included, `true` otherwise.

customExports.description:
Specifies custom exports to add to the package exports in addition to the ones generated by tsdown.
Use this to add additional exports in the exported package, such as workers or assets.

inlinedDependencies.description:
Generate `inlinedDependencies` field in `package.json`.
Lists dependencies that are physically inlined into the bundle with their exact versions.

extensions.description:
Add file extensions to subpath export keys.

When enabled, all subpath exports (except the root `"."`) will include
a `.js` extension in the key (e.g., `"./utils.js"` instead of `"./utils"`).

This follows the Node.js recommendation for subpath exports:

bin.description:
Generate the `bin` field in `package.json` for CLI executables.

Behavior depends on the value:

- *Unset* (default): Soft auto-detect. Scans entry chunks for shebangs
  (e.g. `#!/usr/bin/env node`). If exactly one is found, it is used as
  the bin entry. If multiple are found, a warning is shown and no `bin`
  field is written. If none are found, nothing happens silently.
- `true`: Strict auto-detect. Same as the default, but throws if
  multiple shebang entries are found, and warns if none are found.
  Use this when your package is known to ship a CLI and you want to
  fail fast on misconfiguration.
- `false`: Disable bin generation entirely, even if shebangs are
  present.
- `string`: Use the given source file path (relative to `cwd`) as the
  CLI entry. The command name is derived from the package name without
  its scope. Warns if the source file does not contain a shebang.
- `Record<string, string>`: Explicitly map command names to source file
  paths (relative to `cwd`). Warns for each source file that does not
  contain a shebang.

When {@link ExportsOptions.devExports} is enabled, the `bin` field in
`package.json` points to source files during local development, while
`publishConfig.bin` points to built output paths for publishing.

ui.description:
**[experimental]** Enable devtools integration. `@vitejs/devtools` must be installed as a dependency.

Defaults to true, if `@vitejs/devtools` is installed.

strict.description:
Report warnings as errors. This runs before `level` filters the result, which means that if
`level` is set to `'error'`, all warnings (elevated as errors) will still be reported.

level.description:
The level of messages to log (default: `'suggestion'`).
- `suggestion`: logs all messages
- `warning`: logs only `warning` and `error` messages
- `error`: logs only `error` messages

profile.description:
Profiles select a set of resolution modes to require/ignore. All are evaluated but failures outside
of those required are ignored.

The available profiles are:
- `strict`: requires all resolutions
- `node16`: ignores node10 resolution failures
- `esm-only`: ignores CJS resolution failures

level.description:
The level of the check.

The available levels are:
- `error`: fails the build
- `warn`: warns the build

ignoreRules.description:
List of problem types to ignore by rule name.

The available values are:
- `no-resolution`
- `untyped-resolution`
- `false-cjs`
- `false-esm`
- `cjs-resolves-to-esm`
- `fallback-condition`
- `cjs-only-exports-default`
- `named-exports`
- `false-export-default`
- `missing-export-equals`
- `unexpected-module-syntax`
- `internal-resolution-error`

entrypoints.description:
Exhaustive list of entrypoints to check. The package root is `"."`.
Specifying this option disables automatic entrypoint discovery,
and overrides the `includeEntrypoints` and `excludeEntrypoints` options.

includeEntrypoints.description: Entrypoints to check in addition to automatically discovered ones.

entrypointsLegacy.description:
Whether to automatically consider all published files as entrypoints
in the absence of any other detected or configured entrypoints.

executable.description: Optional, if not specified, uses the current Node.js binary

nodeVersion.description:
Node.js version to use for the executable.

Accepts a valid semver string (e.g., `"25.7.0"`), or the special values
`"latest"` / `"latest-lts"` which resolve the version automatically from
{@link https://nodejs.org/dist/index.json}.

The minimum required version is 25.7.0, which is when ESM entry point
support was added to Node.js SEA.

fileName.description:
Output file name without any suffix or extension.
For example, do not include `.exe`, platform suffixes, or architecture suffixes.

targets.description:
Cross-platform targets for building executables.
Requires `@tsdown/exe` to be installed.
When specified, builds an executable for each target platform/arch combination.

nodeDistIndexUrl.description:
URL of the Node.js release index used to resolve the `latest` and
`latest-lts` versions.

css.description:
**[experimental]** CSS options.
Requires `@tsdown/css` to be installed.

cwd.description:
The working directory of the config file.
- Defaults to {@linkcode process.cwdprocess.cwd()} for root config.
- Defaults to the package directory for {@linkcode workspace} config.

sourcemap.description:
Whether to generate source map files.

Note that this option will always be `true` if you have
{@link https://www.typescriptlang.org/tsconfig/#declarationMap `declarationMap`}
option enabled in your `tsconfig.json`.

write.description:
Whether to write the files to disk.
This option is incompatible with watch mode.

platform.description:
Specifies the target runtime platform for the build.

- `node`: Node.js and compatible runtimes (e.g., Deno, Bun).
  For CJS format, this is always set to `node` and cannot be changed.
- `neutral`: A platform-agnostic target with no specific runtime assumptions.
- `browser`: Web browsers.

env.description: Compile-time env variables, which can be accessed via `import.meta.env` or `process.env`.

shims.description:
Inject CJS `__dirname` and `__filename` shims into ESM output.
Only applies when {@linkcode platform} is set to `node`.

Note: `import.meta.url`, `import.meta.dirname`, and `import.meta.filename`
are always shimmed in CJS output, regardless of this option.

loader.description:
Sets how input files are processed.
For example, use 'js' to treat files as JavaScript or 'base64' for images.
Lets you import or require files like images or fonts.

legacyCjs.description:
If the config includes the `cjs` format and
one of its targets is a Node.js version that supports `require(esm)`
(`^20.19.0 || >=22.12.0`),
warn the user about the deprecation of CommonJS.

checks.description: Controls which warnings are emitted during the build process. Each option can be set to `true` (emit warning) or `false` (suppress warning).

inputOptions.description: Use with caution; ensure you understand the implications.

unbundle.description:
Determines whether `unbundle` is enabled.
When set to `true`, the output files will mirror the input file structure.

fixedExtension.description:
Use a fixed extension for output files.
The extension will always be `.cjs` or `.mjs`.
Otherwise, it will depend on the package type.

Defaults to `true` if {@linkcode platform} is set to `node`,
`false` otherwise.

hash.description: If enabled, appends hash to chunk filenames.

cjsDefault.description:
Converts a single default export from an explicit CJS entry module to
`module.exports`. It does not apply to non-entry chunks emitted in
unbundle mode.

outputOptions.description: Use with caution; ensure you understand the implications.

name.description:
The name to show in CLI output. This is useful for monorepos or workspaces.
When using workspace mode, this option defaults to the package name from package.json.
In non-workspace mode, this option must be set explicitly for the name to show in the CLI output.

onSuccess.description: You can specify command to be executed after a successful build, specially useful for Watch mode

rawEntry.description: Original entry config before glob resolution (for watch mode re-globbing)

root.description: Resolved root directory of input files

include.description:
Workspace directories. Glob patterns are supported.
- `auto`: Automatically detect `package.json` files in the workspace.

exclude.description:
Exclude directories from workspace.
Defaults to all `node_modules`, `dist`, `test`, `tests`, `temp`, and `tmp` directories.

config.description: Path to the workspace configuration file.
